text:
nora: heads-up: running the sampleapp rerank smoke tests and node path is failing while python passes.
nora: node error: TypeError: e.embedding is not iterable
nora: stack:
```
TypeError: e.embedding is not iterable
    at computeScores (/app/lib/rerank.js:78:22)
```
kevin: can you dump the raw embeddings payload for a batched call?
nora: sure. python (ok):
```
[{"id":"p1","embedding":[0.0021,-0.111,...],"model":"open-embed-1536"},{"id":"p2","embedding":[0.0009,0.234,...],"model":"open-embed-1536"}]
```
nora: node (broken):
```
[{"id":"p1","embedding":"0.0021,-0.111,...","model":"open-embed-1536"},{"id":"p2","embedding":"0.0009,0.234,...","model":"open-embed-1536"}]
```
tara: interesting — field name is the same but node is returning a CSV string in the embedding field for batched responses. that will break any code assuming number[]
kevin: do single-item node calls give number[] or string?
nora: single-item node returns number[] as expected. only when input is an array (>1) the SDK collapses each vector into a CSV string.
tara: smells like the response serializer in node's batching helper is joining arrays before sending over the wire, and the client-side deserializer isn't converting back. could be an optimisation gone wrong.
kevin: any chance the auth/retry middleware is concatenating partial chunks and removing array structure? we saw a weird bug last sprint where retry concatenated json fragments.
tara: plausible — if retry code blindly joins chunk buffers it could turn [1,2,3] into "1,2,3" when assembling the final payload.
nora: repro steps:
```js
// repro (node)
const res = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'open-embed-1536', input: ['x','y'] })
console.log(JSON.stringify(res, null, 2))
```
// observed: res[0].embedding is a string CSV
kevin: thanks. short-term mitigation for the sampleapp: add a small helper normalizeEmbeddings(resp) that coerces CSV strings to arrays: if typeof e.embedding === 'string' then e.embedding = e.embedding.split(',').map(Number)
tara: also adding a lightweight middleware in node-samples that runs after the SDK call so onboarding users don't hit this. we'll link to it from the quickstart.
build-bot: CI: embed-shape-check failed on node-samples (expected embedding:number[] but got embedding:string)
kevin: long-term: two fixes: 1) patch the node SDK batching helper to preserve numeric arrays on round-trip; 2) add an integration test that compares python vs node sample responses for all embedding endpoints to catch regressions.
tara: i'll own the SDK patch + test. i'll also audit the retry/concat code path to see if we accidentally stringified during buffer assembly.
nora: opened sampleapp PR with normalization middleware and test (redwood/devex#1403). added note in onboarding doc about this temporary fix.
kevin: nice. can you also leave a small snippet teams can paste into older node versions (1-liner)? will save support time.
tara: yeah: `const ensureVec = v => typeof v === 'string' ? v.split(',').map(Number) : v`
kevin: great — schedule a patch release after unit tests, target for tonight's patch window. tagging @tara for follow-up. :rocket:
